messages:
incident-bot: P0 alert: elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate across hosted region us-west-2 — client errors visible to multiple customers. Paging oncall (@maya). Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.dev/p0-gen-errors
maya (oncall): on it. currently commuting but availability = 5m. anyone have a rough impact estimate? which customers? :eyes:
sam (support): Customer ticket batch: several enterprise customers report timeouts and truncated responses, severity high. I have the list, sharing after this thread.
jordan (sre): ack. I see error spike in metrics, correlating with tokenizer service timeouts. Querying logs now. If anyone can take customer front-facing comms, @anya?
anya (product): I can draft a short message for status page. Need ETA window & mitigation plan.
leo (eng-runtime): On-call, can we divert to fallback model? We have a canary fallback (quantized v1) that should drop latency. I can flip a route if we confirm impact from model runtime.
maya (oncall): jordan, priority to confirm service/component boundary. leo, hold on toggle until we confirm root cause. Sam please post affected orgs to support thread so we can coordinate comms.
jordan (sre): quick repro query I'm running:
```sql
-- find errors for generate endpoint in last 15m
SELECT timestamp, request_id, service, error_type, latency_ms
FROM raw_service_logs
WHERE path = '/v1/generate'
  AND timestamp >= now() - interval '15 minutes'
  AND status_code >= 500
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
jordan (sre): results are weird — I only see partial results for 1839123380-1839123500 range; seems like sampling changed on the ingestion side around 1839123400.
logbot: Note: sampling policy change deployed 1839123390 by ingestion-team (change-id: samp-rollout-2026-03).
maya (oncall): that explains gaps. who rolled that? ingestion-team please respond. we need full logs for RCA, not sampled.
leo (eng-runtime): if logs missing, we can still reconstruct traces via KV cache metrics + prom counters. jordan, can you pull prom for `runtime.kv_cache.misses` and `tokenizer.timeouts`?
jordan (sre): running prom queries now. also trying raw S3 bucket for un-sampled copies: `s3://raw-logs/us-west-2/` with prefix 2026/03/15/1839*/. may take a minute.
sam (support): posted affected orgs in #support-enterprise: AcmeCorp, BrightWave, FinVault. Recommending we include mitigation and ETA in comms.
anya (product): Draft status (for review): "We are investigating elevated errors in generation. Traffic rerouting and mitigation under way; more details in 30m." Any objections?
maya (oncall): fine, post it with note about potential degraded responses, not data loss. jordan, update when you have prom and raw logs.
jordan (sre): prom snippet: `tokenizer.timeouts` shows spike starting at ~1839123365, peaked 1839123420. `runtime.kv_cache.misses` also increased ~2x. Putting raw query output here, limited due to sampling:
```
1839123421 | req-0a1b | tokenizer | TimeoutError | 1200ms
1839123420 | req-0a1c | tokenizer | TimeoutError | 1100ms
1839123417 | req-0a1d | tokenizer | TimeoutError | 1300ms
... (sampling omitted some entries)
```
leo (eng-runtime): hypothesis 1: tokenizer service degraded and caused backpressure into runtime, increasing latency and exposing cache misses. Hypothesis 2: simultaneous ingestion sampling change removed key diagnostics, slowing investigation.
maya (oncall): logging hypothesis tracked. Action items: 1) @leo prepare fallback route plan, 2) @jordan try S3 raw logs pull and attach to thread, 3) @sam publish customer list & initial status, 4) @anya post status page.
leo (eng-runtime): start rollback of sampling change? That was ingestion change but might fix visibility. @ingestion-team please confirm. If we can restore full ingestion we can get the missing logs for 18391233xx.
ingestion-team (via thread): rolling back sampling policy now; backfill scheduled for raw logs, ETA 45m.
jordan (sre): S3 raw logs command (running): `aws s3 cp --recursive s3://raw-logs/us-west-2/2026/03/15/1839 --exclude '*' --include '*generate*' ./tmp-logs/`
jordan (sre): partial copy completed; attaching sample from S3 (pasted below). Looks like tokenizer process restarted around 1839123418, heap GC spikes reported.
```
[1839123415] tokenizer pid=2384 mem_rss=1.8G gc_pause=45ms
[1839123417] tokenizer pid=2384 gc_pause=1200ms ERROR Timeout
[1839123418] tokenizer restart pid=4923 command=/opt/tokenizer --shard=usw2
```
maya (oncall): good find. leo, does a tokenizer restart align with any recent deployments?
leo (eng-runtime): there was a minor tokenizer config update rolled 1839123405 (limit tuning). I'll open a follow-up with infra but recommend we rollback that config to previous stable.
maya (oncall): do the rollback. leo, coordinate with infra. jordan, keep pulling logs and build timeline. I'll own incident coordination and paging.
anya (product): status page posted: "Investigating elevated generation errors in US-WEST-2; mitigation and rollbacks in progress. Customers may see timeouts or truncated responses. Updates every 30 minutes."
sam (support): notifying affected accounts that we have mitigation plan and ETA ~45m. Getting a couple of angry replies, escalating to account managers.
leo (eng-runtime): rollback applied for tokenizer config at 1839123725. Monitor shows error rate decreasing.
jordan (sre): metrics confirm 5xx rate down ~60% since rollback. KV cache misses trending back to baseline. Pulling final logs for timeline.
jordan (sre): timeline draft (will expand):
- 1839123360: sampling policy change deploy (ingestion-team)
- 1839123405: tokenizer config tuning deploy (runtime team)
- 1839123417: tokenizer GC spike and TimeoutErrors begin
- 1839123418: tokenizer restarted
- 1839123725: rollback of tokenizer config
- 1839123760: error rates decline
maya (oncall): solid. We should include root cause note: interaction of config tuning causing GC pressure, observed alongside sampling policy change that hindered immediate insight. That combination delayed triage.
anya (product): note for RCA: customer impact summary + timeline + actions (rollback, ingestion sampling rollback, backfill, improved alerting). I'll start skeleton.
jordan (sre): investigation note: create follow-ups: 1) require canary retention sample before ingestion sampling rollouts, 2) ensure tokenizer config changes are gate-kept by memory probes in canary, 3) alert when prom GC pause > 500ms.
maya (oncall): agreed. closing loop on active mitigation. If errors resurface, re-open paging. For post-incident: schedule RCA write-up and attach S3 logs.
sam (support): will compile customer comms and reopen tickets with updates.
leo (eng-runtime): filing PR to revert default tokenizer tuning and add canary test. tagging infra and ingestion for follow-ups.
incident-bot: Incident marked as "mitigated" at 1839123798 by maya (oncall). RCA channel draft: #postmortems/inc-1839123456
maya (oncall): thanks team. major thanks to ingestion-team for quick rollback. Follow-ups assigned in trunk: INFRA-129, INGEST-78, RUNTIME-402.
